name: Shilhak-Inshushinak
role: King of Elam and a king of the Shutrukid Dynasty
contribution: King of Elam from about 1150 to 1120 BC and a member of the Shutrukid ruling dynasty.
legacy: When he replaced his older brother, Kutir-Nahhunte II, he became the last great king of Elam.

checks.lead: Shilhak-Inshushinak I (Elamite: Šilḫak-Inšušinak, meaning "Powered by Inshushinak") was king of Elam from about 1150 to 1120 BC and a member of the Shutrukid ruling dynasty. He was the son of Shutruk-Nahhunte I.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
